### Admin portal / dashboard

Signed-in portal to manage records (patients, students, products…) with a dashboard. Data lives in Supabase.

- ✅ **Must have:** login, app-frame, dashboard-stat-card, data-table, filter-bar, record-form, form-field, record-detail, confirm-dialog, empty-state, profile, not-found
- ➕ **Optional:** signup, forgot-password, dashboard-chart *(on by default)*, export-button *(on by default)*, settings, users-roles, file-upload, notifications, activity-log
- 🏭 **Switched on per industry:** healthcare → activity-log; hrms → users-roles; erp → users-roles, activity-log
- 📦 **Modules:** industry presets (platform-main/src/portal/portalDefaults.js INDUSTRY_MODULES); the user can edit them in the wizard

| Page | Path | Rooms (in order) |
|---|---|---|
| Login | `/login` | login |
| Create account *(only if signup is on)* | `/signup` | signup |
| Forgot password *(only if forgot-password is on)* | `/forgot-password` | forgot-password |
| Dashboard | `/` | app-frame → notifications → dashboard-stat-card → dashboard-chart → activity-log |
| Module list *(one per module)* | `/:module` | app-frame → notifications → filter-bar → export-button → data-table → empty-state → confirm-dialog |
| Add record *(one per module)* | `/:module/new` | app-frame → record-form → form-field → file-upload |
| Edit record *(one per module)* | `/:module/:id/edit` | app-frame → record-form → form-field → file-upload |
| Record details *(one per module)* | `/:module/:id` | app-frame → record-detail → confirm-dialog |
| My profile | `/profile` | app-frame → profile |
| Settings *(only if settings is on)* | `/settings` | app-frame → settings |
| Users & roles *(only if users-roles is on)* | `/users` | app-frame → users-roles |
| 404 | `*` | not-found |

### Booking / appointment site

Public booking page: choose a service, pick a free time, enter details and get a confirmation.

- ✅ **Must have:** navbar, hero, services-list, slot-picker, booking-form, booking-confirmation, footer, not-found
- ➕ **Optional:** team, testimonials, faq *(on by default)*, location-map
- 🏭 **Switched on per industry:** healthcare → team, location-map, faq; school → team, faq; generic → testimonials, faq

| Page | Path | Rooms (in order) |
|---|---|---|
| Book (one page) | `/` | navbar → hero → services-list → slot-picker → booking-form → team → testimonials → faq → location-map → footer |
| Booking confirmed | `/booked` | navbar → booking-confirmation → footer |
| 404 | `*` | not-found |

### E-commerce store

Online shop: products, product pages, cart and checkout with payment (practice cards in test mode, Razorpay/Stripe through a server function).

- ✅ **Must have:** navbar, hero, product-list, product-page, cart, checkout-payment, order-confirmation, footer, not-found
- ➕ **Optional:** testimonials, faq *(on by default)*, newsletter, cta-banner
- 🏭 **Switched on per industry:** inventory → testimonials, newsletter; generic → faq, cta-banner

| Page | Path | Rooms (in order) |
|---|---|---|
| Shop home | `/` | navbar → hero → product-list → testimonials → cta-banner → faq → newsletter → footer |
| Product | `/product/:id` | navbar → product-page → footer |
| Cart | `/cart` | navbar → cart → footer |
| Checkout and payment | `/checkout` | navbar → checkout-payment → footer |
| Order confirmed | `/order-confirmation` | navbar → order-confirmation → footer |
| 404 | `*` | not-found |

## 2. Style levels

Every level may use: `react`, `react-dom`, `lucide-react`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `class-variance-authority`, `radix-ui`.

| Level | Look | Motion | Extra packages | Reduce-motion | Max size / component | Site speed (Lighthouse) | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Basic** | Clean, flat and simple. No animation. | none | none | — | 15 KB | ≥ 90 | shadcn/ui, own templates |
| **Good** | Polished: shadows, hover effects, smooth CSS transitions. | css | none | required | 20 KB | ≥ 90 | shadcn blocks, Tremor, own templates |
| **Amazing** | Smooth animations and gradients. | js | `framer-motion`, `motion` | required | 60 KB | ≥ 80 | Magic UI, Aceternity UI (free items) |
| **Astonishing** | Wow effects: 3D, glow, moving backgrounds. | js | `framer-motion`, `motion`, `gsap`, `@gsap/react` | required | 150 KB | ≥ 70 | Aceternity UI, Magic UI, GSAP effects |

Workflow rooms get 2 skins in V1 (basic, good); visual rooms get every level their website types allow.

| **heading** | string | Section title |
| serviceName | string | The chosen service, or empty if none yet |
| **date** | string | Chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD |
| **minDate** | string | Earliest day allowed |
| **maxDate** | string | Latest day allowed |
| **slots** | list of Slot | Times on the chosen day |
| selectedSlotId | string | Chosen time ('HH:MM') |
| closedMessage | string | Shown when the day has no times |
| **onDateChange** | function (date: string) => void | Choose a day |
| **onSelect** | function (slotId: string) => void | Choose a time |

### `booking-form` · workflow · booking

Name, email and phone to finish the booking. The shell saves it. *Used by: booking.*

| Prop | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **heading** | string | Section title |
| summary | string | One line: what is being booked and when |
| **ready** | boolean | False until a service and a time are chosen |
| **onSubmit** | function (values: { name: string; email: string; phone: string; notes: string }) => Promise<void> | Book it |
| **submitting** | boolean | True while saving / sending |
| error | string | Error message to show, if any |

### `booking-confirmation` · workflow · booking

'You are booked' page with the reference number. *Used by: booking.*

| Prop | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **heading** | string | Section title |
| **reference** | string | Booking reference |
| **serviceName** | string | What was booked |
| **whenLabel** | string | When, in words |
| name | string | Who booked |
| email | string | Where the confirmation goes |
| **homeHref** | url | Link back home |

## 4. Shared shapes

- **Brand**: Name and logo of the site / portal. — **name**: string · logoUrl: image · logoText: string
- **NavLink**: One item in a menu. — **label**: string · **href**: url · icon: icon · active: boolean
- **Cta**: A call-to-action button. — **label**: string · **href**: url
- **SocialLink**: A contact or social profile link. — **type**: email / phone / github / linkedin / twitter / instagram / website / other · **label**: string · **href**: url
- **ImageRef**: An image with alt text. — **src**: image · **alt**: string · caption: string
- **Feature**: A feature / service item. — **title**: string · **description**: text · icon: icon
- **Stat**: A number with a label. — **value**: string · **label**: string
- **Project**: A portfolio project. — **title**: string · **description**: text · tags: list of string · image: image · href: url · repoHref: url · featured: boolean
- **TimelineItem**: One entry of experience or education. — **title**: string · **organization**: string · **period**: string · location: string · description: text · bullets: list of string
- **SkillGroup**: A named group of skills. — **name**: string · **items**: list of string
- **Testimonial**: A quote from a client or colleague. — **quote**: text · **author**: string · role: string · avatar: image
- **PricingPlan**: One pricing plan. — **name**: string · **price**: string · period: string · **features**: list of string · **cta**: Cta · highlighted: boolean
- **FaqItem**: A question and its answer. — **question**: string · **answer**: text
- **TeamMember**: A team member. — **name**: string · **role**: string · photo: image · links: list of SocialLink
- **Product**: One item for sale. — **id**: string · **name**: string · description: text · **price**: number · compareAtPrice: number · image: image · category: string · badge: string · inStock: boolean
- **CartLine**: One line in the cart. — **productId**: string · **name**: string · **price**: number · **qty**: number · image: image
- **Service**: Something a customer can book. — **id**: string · **name**: string · description: text · **durationMin**: number · price: number
- **Slot**: One bookable time on the chosen day. — **id**: string · **label**: string · **available**: boolean
- **UserSummary**: The signed-in user. — **name**: string · **email**: string · avatarUrl: image · role: string
- **FieldDef**: One form field (from the portal config). — **key**: string · **label**: string · **type**: text / email / password / phone / url / textarea / number / currency / percentage / rating / select / multi-select / checkbox / checkbox-group / toggle / radio / date / time / datetime / file / image / avatar / tags / color / address / json / reference · **required**: boolean · options: list of string · width: full / half / third · placeholder: string · helpText: string
- **Column**: One table column. — **key**: string · **label**: string · type: text / email / password / phone / url / textarea / number / currency / percentage / rating / select / multi-select / checkbox / checkbox-group / toggle / radio / date / time / datetime / file / image / avatar / tags / color / address / json / reference · sortable: boolean
- **SortState**: Current sort. — **key**: string · **dir**: asc / desc
- **PageState**: Current page of a list. — **page**: number · **pageSize**: number · **total**: number
- **RowAction**: An action button on a table row. — **id**: view / edit / delete · **label**: string · **onSelect**: function (row: Record<string, unknown>) => void
- **FilterDef**: A filter dropdown. — **key**: string · **label**: string · **options**: list of string
- **ChartPoint**: One point / bar / slice. — **label**: string · **value**: number
- **ActivityItem**: One activity-log entry. — **actor**: string · **action**: string · target: string · **at**: date
- **NotificationItem**: One notification. — **id**: string · **title**: string · body: text · **at**: date · **read**: boolean
- **SettingsSection**: A group of settings fields. — **id**: string · **title**: string · **fields**: list of FieldDef
